verdict.rationale: Omnara lets a developer launch agents (backed by models like Claude/OpenAI) with MCP tool access and skills, and community comments imply these agents autonomously write/edit code that then needs human review — but there is no explicit documentation or example of an agent diagnosing a bug report and producing a fix end-to-end; Omnara is presented as an orchestration/remote-control layer rather than the coding-agent logic itself. missing for 10: explicit bug-diagnosis-and-fix workflow documentation, first-party or independent example of an agent resolving a real bug, evidence that fix quality/success is verified.
